+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9e80'
+title: The shipped standard default is a vision-language model, and generation hangs with zero tokens
+---
+### What
+
+The shipped standard default cannot generate. A prompt turn makes no
+token, makes no tool call, and never ends. `acp-agent` does no work at
+all on the model it ships.
+
+`ProfileConfiguration.defaultStandard` is
+`mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit`, set by `^k4rq6ab`.
+
+### The evidence
+
+**The eval, on the shipped model.** All 12 samples read the same:
+
+```
+greet: stop=none turns=1 toolCalls=0 tokens=0/0 elapsed=300s
+       model=mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit
+```
+
+`stop=none` and 300 s is the idle ceiling, so the turn never ended.
+
+**The stall watchdog, from the unified log.** One generation stayed in
+flight for 52 minutes and made no token:
+
+```
+[FoundationModelsRouter:Generation] session 01M20ND7QMC0ER1DPCHQ3DJAAQ:
+generation has produced no fragment in 3120.5s (0 so far, 3120.5s in flight)
+```
+
+A second run repeated it at once, so it is not intermittent:
+
+```
+session 01M215NSPZBB7C1KYJVFCKVNCC:
+generation has produced no fragment in 30.0s (0 so far, 30.0s in flight)
+```
+
+The flash slot, `mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-4bit`, makes fragments in the
+same process. Only the standard slot hangs.
+
+**The cause, from the model's own `config.json`.** The downloaded model
+is complete — 15 G in three shards — and it is not a text model:
+
+```
+model_type:          qwen3_5
+architectures:       ["Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"]
+language_model_only: False
+text_config:         qwen3_5_text, 64 layers, 262144 context
+vision_config:       a full vision tower (deepstack_visual_indexes, ...)
+```
+
+It also ships `preprocessor_config.json`,
+`video_preprocessor_config.json` and `processor_config.json`, and it
+declares `image_token_id`, `video_token_id`, `vision_start_token_id` and
+`vision_end_token_id`.
+
+`mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit` is a VISION-LANGUAGE model, and the
+standard slot loads it through the text path. The cached
+`mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` is the same architecture, so a change
+of quantisation does not answer this.
+
+### What to do
+
+A person chooses between two answers. Do not choose alone.
+
+1. **Make the default a text model.** Find the text-only Qwen3.5 build
+   of this size, prove it generates, and set
+   `ProfileConfiguration.defaultStandard` to it. The smaller change.
+2. **Support the vision-language path.** `MLXVLM` is already in the
+   build. Load a model whose `language_model_only` is `False` through
+   the VLM loader. The larger change, and it may belong upstream in
+   `FoundationModelsRouter` — which then needs its own card, discussed
+   first.
+
+Whichever answer wins, add the guard below.
+
+- [ ] Decide between the two answers, with a person
+- [ ] Make the standard slot generate on the shipped default
+- [ ] Refuse a model the loader cannot drive, instead of hanging
+
+### The guard this card must add whatever the answer
+
+A model the loader cannot drive must be REFUSED at resolution, with a
+message that names the model and the reason. It must never hang.
+
+A 52 minute generation with zero tokens is the worst failure shape
+there is: the run reports nothing, the person waits, and the log says
+"in flight". `doctor` should read the same fact and report it, and the
+card `^m476zb` ("doctor checks: the profile") is where that check
+belongs.
+
+### Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `acp-agent run "hello"` on the shipped default writes an answer.
+- [ ] A prompt turn on the shipped default reports a stop reason. No
+      turn ends by the idle ceiling with `stop=none`.
+- [ ] A model the loader cannot drive is refused at resolution, and the
+      message names the model and the reason.
+- [ ] The tier-4 eval samples report a stop reason and a token count
+      that is not zero.
+
+### Tests
+
+- [ ] A test asserts that a model whose `language_model_only` is `False`
+      is either driven correctly or refused with a named reason. It must
+      not hang.
+- [ ] The refusal test states its own time bound, so a hang fails it
+      rather than running to the suite ceiling.
+
+### What this card is NOT
+
+It is not the `runCode` snippet question. `^95jyv07` recorded parse
+failures, and those came from the stale eval pin
+(`Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-4bit`) and not from this agent. Nothing is
+yet known about how the shipped model writes snippets, because it has
+never written one.

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m2166hs5f3yqahd08ek1wht3
+  text: |-
+    ### Correction — 2026-09-08. The VLM reading was wrong.
+
+    This card said the model hangs because it is a vision-language model
+    driven through the text path, and that a change of quantisation "does
+    not answer this". **Both statements are wrong, and I measured them
+    rather than inferring this time.**
+
+    **Measured:** `acp-agent run "say hello"` with the standard slot pinned
+    to `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4` wrote to stdout:
+
+    ```
+    Hello! 👋 How can I help you today?
+    ```
+
+    Real tokens, no stall entry. The same command on
+    `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit` makes no token and hangs.
+
+    **So the architecture is not the cause.** Both builds are
+    `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` with `language_model_only: False` and
+    a full vision tower. Only the quantisation differs:
+
+    | build | quantisation | result |
+    |---|---|---|
+    | `-4bit` | affine, group_size 64 | hangs, zero tokens, 52 minutes in flight |
+    | `-mxfp4` | mxfp4, group_size 32 | generates |
+
+    **The family already runs the working build.** The `-4bit` pin in this
+    package is the only place that names it:
+
+    - `FoundationModelsMultitool` — `Sources/MultitoolCLI/CLIRunner.swift:410`,
+      `generationModel: ModelRef = "mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4"`.
+    - `FoundationModelsRouter` — `Tests/.../JointFitTests.swift:835`,
+      `multitoolGeneration: ModelRef = "org/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4"`.
+    - `FoundationModelsRouter` — `Tests/.../CompactionEvalTiers.swift:197`
+      carries real eval numbers "for Qwen3.8-27B (the standard model)".
+    - `FoundationModelsRouter` — `Sources/.../Sizing/RepoMetadata.swift:283`
+      reads the nested `text_config`, so a repo of this shape sizes
+      correctly.
+
+    So `^k4rq6ab` chose `-4bit` when the rest of the family had settled on
+    `-mxfp4`, and nothing ever drove the `-4bit` build until today.
+
+    ### What this card now asks
+
+    1. Set `ProfileConfiguration.defaultStandard` to
+       `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-mxfp4`, and say in the doc comment that
+       the family pins this build and where.
+    2. Keep the guard. A generation that makes no token must be refused or
+       reported, and never hang for 52 minutes. That stands whatever the
+       default is, and it is what made this cost a day.
+
+    The "support the vision-language path" option is dropped. The text path
+    drives this model correctly at the mxfp4 quantisation.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-08T18:58:59.493868+00:00

+    ### Where the guard belongs, and why it belongs here
+
+    I looked for the honest owner before I wrote code.
+
+    Router already emits `SessionEvent.generationStalled(GenerationStall)`,
+    and `RoutedSession.streamEvents(to:maxTokens:)` states in its own doc
+    comment that the event travels on the turn stream, "on each interval
+    without a fragment". That is the stream `PromptTurn.drive` already
+    consumes. So this package sees the stall as it happens, and no change
+    in Router is necessary for a run-time guard.
+
+    `streamEvents` also states: "Abandoning this stream cancels the turn."
+    So leaving the drive loop is the sanctioned way to stop the generation.
+    The guard needs no `cancelCurrentTurn()` call, and `drive` keeps its
+    one parameter, which is what lets the tests drive it with a synthetic
+    stream.
+
+    `EventProjection` already tracked `sawOutput` for the `_no_output` stop
+    reason of `^pez780d`. It is now `private(set)`, so the drive loop reads
+    it beside the stall report. That is the second half of the guard, and
+    it is what stops a slow tool from reading as a hung model.
+
+    The model name comes from
+    `ConfigOptions.handle(for: entry.selectedSlot, of: residentProfile)`,
+    the same string `/status` shows. `PromptTurn` carries it, so the log
+    line names the model.

+    and the loader is Router's. This package receives an already resident

+    stream. So the run-time guard is the honest answer here, and a
